away.summary: The Rangers (7-4-1) are missing goaltenders Igor Shesterkin and Joonas Korpisalo, along with forward Joseph Veleno, due to lower-body injuries. Dylan Garand is projected to make his seventh consecutive start, with Spencer Martin as backup. Scott Morrow, Matt Rempe, and Matthew Robertson are scratched, while Luke Glendening could make his Rangers debut after signing Thursday.

home.summary: The Senators (7-4-0) will be without Linus Ullmark (1-2 weeks, IR), William Eklund, Kurtis MacDermid, and Thomas Chabot due to injuries. Jonas Johansson is projected to start and make his Senators debut, with Samuel Ersson as backup. Andre Burakovsky returns to the lineup after being a healthy scratch the past two games, while Hayden Hodgson comes out. Chabot is expected to return during the upcoming five-game road trip.
